chapter: Maynard Ferguson and Dizzy's big band
title: The Hi Fly arrangement on Sister Salvation
summary: A surprise arrangement from someone not usually writing for the octet was the best they had.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Hi Fly. I go back and listen to that arrangement now, and I say, boy, I had to be dumb not to hear this, to see this. I was dumb then, and I know it, because I didn’t see this, and now, when I hear it, it’s obvious. This guy wrote an arrangement that was just worlds above our stuff.
The recording that we’re talking about that that’s on is Sister Salvation, which was the Atlantic recording. I’d never heard of that gentleman before or since.

Or since. He never wrote anything for us after that. He might have written one, but it wasn’t – that arrangement, when I first heard it, scared me. Almost had to leave the rehearsal. I have to get out of there.
